status_definitions.no_qualified_model_identified: No exact registered model or qualified source candidate was identified in this bounded repository audit. This is not a claim that none exists anywhere.
status_definitions.illustrative_only_unregistered: A relevant licensed visual model exists externally, but it is not dimensionally defensible as the item's volume and must not be presented as mesh-volume calibrated.
status_definitions.unregistered_candidate_requires_review: A relevant source model exists, but scene scope, rights dependencies, or isolated-body geometry remains unverified; do not register or import yet.

items.name: Proton volume
items.blocker: Quantum charge-density extent is not a uniquely bounded solid body; use a labeled distribution visualization, not a solid mesh-volume claim.

items.name: Hydrogen atom volume
items.blocker: The Bohr-radius-derived effective volume is a convention, not a hard atomic boundary; any shell must be labeled as a probability/scale illustration.

items.name: Water molecule volume
items.blocker: Molecular volume depends on the chosen electron-density or van-der-Waals boundary; no licensed exact source geometry matching the current definition is registered.

items.name: SARS-CoV-2 virion volume
items.blocker: A spherical envelope is an approximation; a model would need an explicit virion boundary and source rights, not an unqualified capsid mesh.

items.name: Influenza virion volume
items.blocker: Virions vary in shape and size; no exact licensed model tied to the representative spherical-volume definition is identified.

items.name: Escherichia coli cell volume
items.blocker: Cell volume varies with strain and growth conditions; require a measured specimen or clearly identified representative cell model.

items.name: Human cell volume
items.blocker: There is no single typical human-cell geometry; organelle/whole-cell renderings need an explicit cell type, boundary and compatible license.

items.name: Grain of salt volume
items.blocker: The record is a representative spherical approximation; an actual irregular grain would need measured dimensions and matching size provenance.

items.name: Raindrop volume
items.blocker: The listed 5 mm spherical droplet is a simplifying convention; real falling-drop shape depends on size and airflow.

items.name: Sugar cube volume
items.blocker: The item is a representative solid block; a candidate needs documented edge dimensions and an actual cube-like mesh.

items.name: Bathtub
items.blocker: This observation is capacity (about 150 L), not tub-material volume. CC BY bathtub props lack documented dimensions/capacity; if used, tag as capacity proxy and make no mesh-volume claim.

candidate_sources.creator: Aparicio Silva 3D
candidate_sources.license: CC BY (Sketchfab page); verify license at acquisition
candidate_sources.limitation: Authored game prop; no metric dimensions or water-capacity evidence.

candidate_sources.creator: Igrium
candidate_sources.license: CC BY (Sketchfab page); verify license at acquisition
candidate_sources.limitation: Blender recreation without dimensions or capacity; exact upstream game-asset relationship is unclear.

items.name: Bathtub volume
items.blocker: This is water capacity, not the solid material volume of the tub. An external tub model can only be a capacity proxy; do not calibrate from enclosed mesh volume.

candidate_sources.creator: Aparicio Silva 3D
candidate_sources.license: CC BY (Sketchfab page); verify license at acquisition
candidate_sources.limitation: No documented scale, basin capacity, or water volume.

items.name: Room volume
items.blocker: A representative interior needs dimensions and a clear wall/ceiling boundary; generic room assets are not calibrated to the selected example.

items.name: Swimming pool
items.blocker: The 40 m^3 observation is water capacity; a pool shell/envelope is not the water volume unless fill level and basin geometry are explicit.

items.name: Apartment
items.blocker: Representative interior volume needs a dimensioned apartment plan/model matching the record; an attractive room scene is not sufficient.

items.name: Classroom volume
items.blocker: Needs room dimensions and an explicit interior-air boundary; generic classroom models may include furniture or omit architectural surfaces.

items.name: Apartment volume
items.blocker: Representative interior-air volume requires a dimensionally controlled plan and a defined inside boundary.

items.name: House interior volume
items.blocker: Representative interior volume requires an identified house plan and consistent treatment of floors, walls, attic and excluded spaces.

items.name: Olympic swimming pool
items.blocker: Capacity depends on the selected competition dimensions and water depth; require a source model or plan matching the cited pool convention.

items.name: Oil tanker cargo volume
items.blocker: Cargo capacity is not hull displacement or outer hull volume; a particular vessel and tank-capacity source are needed.

items.name: Great Pyramid of Giza volume
items.blocker: The selected value is an approximate geometric envelope (~2.6 million m^3). The CC BY PAPP Sketchfab file describes a watertight whole-plateau bas-relief containing multiple pyramids, Sphinx, causeway and terrain, not an isolated calibrated Khufu mesh. Verify source/dependency rights and isolate the pyramid before considering import.

candidate_sources.creator: consciousfractal
candidate_sources.license: CC BY as shown on Sketchfab page
candidate_sources.limitation: Scene is a procedural plateau model; the page cites a Petrie slope (~51.844 degrees) but does not establish an isolated export or absolute scale.

candidate_sources.creator: ianicolo
candidate_sources.license: CC BY as shown on Sketchfab page
candidate_sources.limitation: Photogrammetry from YouTube videos; prior review found poor metric/completeness evidence and approximately 360k triangles. Rejected for measurement.

items.name: Lake Tahoe volume
items.blocker: Water volume requires bathymetry and a defined lake level; surrounding terrain topography alone is not the water body.

items.name: Mount Everest envelope volume
items.blocker: An above-terrain envelope needs a defined base surface, summit and clipping boundary; ordinary elevation relief is not this volume.

items.name: Earth's oceans
items.blocker: Ocean volume requires a bathymetric water-column calculation and a sea-level/datum convention; a globe or ocean-surface map is not volume geometry.

items.name: Betelgeuse volume
items.blocker: The observation is radius-dependent and uncertain; any stellar sphere is an explicitly idealized volume proxy, not a resolved 3D stellar surface.

items.name: Oort Cloud volume
items.blocker: The 50,000 AU spherical boundary is a theoretical convention, not a measured shell; a boundary diagram must be labeled as such.

items.name: Orion Nebula volume
items.blocker: Projected emission maps do not uniquely determine depth; a 3D volume model needs distances and a defined nebular boundary.

items.name: Milky Way disk volume
items.blocker: The disk volume depends on chosen radial and vertical extents; require a sourced 3D stellar-density field and a declared cutoff.

items.name: Local Group volume
items.blocker: A spherical volume depends on a chosen Local Group radius/boundary; member positions alone do not define a filled volume.

items.name: Virgo Supercluster volume
items.blocker: The supercluster boundary is definition-dependent; a spherical proxy should not be presented as a mapped matter volume.

items.name: Observable universe volume
items.blocker: This is a derived spherical cosmological volume, not a solid surface model; a scale diagram would be illustrative rather than observed geometry.
